name: io.github.ancilis/heel
description: Heel reviews a SaaS product model before launch and returns ranked abuse paths, missing controls, and regression tests. The heel_review_openapi MCP tool analyzes an inline OpenAPI document locally, makes no analyzer network calls, and saves the heel.review.v1 result under HEEL_HOME. Heel exposes no scope-mutation tools.

environment_variables.name: HEEL_HOME
environment_variables.description: Private local data directory for saved reviews, signed authorization scopes, the SQLite store, and the tamper-evident containment log (default ./.heel).

environment_variables.name: HEEL_SIGNING_KEY
environment_variables.description: Path to the HMAC signing key. For production, set this OUTSIDE HEEL_HOME (key/data separation).

environment_variables.name: HEEL_MODEL
environment_variables.description: Set to 'anthropic' to enable the optional LLM control loop (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Defaults to the deterministic offline model.
